result.reason: The added language does not effectively reconcile the existing provisions. Article XX still automatically terminates the licence on a Change of Control absent consent, directly undermining the new M&A-successor assignment right. Article IV still permits immediate termination for any breach, conflicting with the new material-breach, notice-and-cure standard. The existing restrictions on sublicensing, outsourcing, disclosure and third-party access also remain and may conflict with Affiliate and contractor use. In addition, globally deeming all references to Licensee employees to include Affiliate, contractor and introducing-broker personnel is unnecessarily broad and may alter unrelated obligations. Any applicable paid-up licence is not made expressly perpetual and irrevocable. These conflicts prevent the draft from reliably reaching either the preferred or fallback position.
